description: Compares the Iron/Out UX Score of 2 to 5 websites side by side, using real-user Chrome UX Report (CrUX) data from the last 28 days (Web Vitals: TTFB, FCP, LCP, INP, CLS). Use this for competitor or sector comparisons. It runs no lab test or Lighthouse. Returns a ranking and a link to the full comparison.

category.description: Sector label shown in the report, for example Electronics. It does not change the scores.

language.description: Language of the linked report. Use nl when the user writes in Dutch.

urls.description: The websites to compare, for example ["zalando.nl", "wehkamp.nl"].

name: compare_sites
title: Compare sites
